name: Rust build outputs
rebuildNote: Cargo normally regenerates compiled outputs and build-script generated source on the next build.
limitation: High risk: review and select explicitly. Stop Cargo, rustc and rust-analyzer first. Generated source is allowed only inside verified build-script OUT_DIR after Git and process checks. Preserve manual edits, custom deliverables and files that cannot be rebuilt.

name: Node.js dependencies
rebuildNote: Reinstall dependencies with the project's package manager.
limitation: Requires network access or a local package cache. Preserve patched, linked, private and unpublished packages.

name: Node.js build caches
rebuildNote: The framework recreates these outputs during development or the next build.
limitation: Stop development servers first. Review deployment outputs and locally generated data.

name: Swift package build outputs
rebuildNote: Swift Package Manager normally regenerates compiled products and derived source on the next build.
limitation: High risk: review and select explicitly. Stop Swift builds first. Only verified debug or release product directories are targeted; source checkouts, repositories, credentials and package configuration are retained. Preserve custom products and manual edits to generated source.

name: Python bytecode caches

limitation: Review the directory contents and stop active Python tasks first.

name: Python test caches
rebuildNote: Pytest recreates test-state caches on the next run.
